operations.name: count.add
operations.description: Count Tool: add a numbered count marker at doc coordinate x,y. Omit group_id to use the active count group; group_name/color can create or update the group.

group_id.description: Count group id; defaults to active group

group_name.description: Group name when creating/updating a group

operations.name: count.clear
operations.description: Count Tool: clear all count markers, or only one group when group_id is provided.

group_id.description: Count group id to clear; omit to clear every count marker

operations.name: count.list
operations.description: Count Tool: list count groups and numbered count markers.
